name: crap
description: Runs the tests under coverage and flags functions that are complex and poorly covered, where a change is most likely to break something.
install: brew upgrade kenmclennan/tap/recognizer-sense-crap || brew install kenmclennan/tap/recognizer-sense-crap

settings.description: the C.R.A.P. score above which a function is reported, above 0; default 30
settings.label: Report above

settings.description: the line coverage below which a function is reported, above 0 and at most 1; false turns the coverage finding off; default 0.6
settings.label: Report coverage below

settings.description: where the sensor writes its overlay, relative to the repository; default .recognizer/cache/overlays/crap.json

metrics.name: complexity
metrics.label: cc
metrics.title: Complexity
metrics.help: How many independent paths run through the function; more paths are harder to test and to change.

metrics.name: crap
metrics.label: CRAP
metrics.title: C.R.A.P. score
metrics.help: Complexity weighed against how well tests cover each function.

metrics.name: coverage
metrics.label: cov
metrics.title: Coverage
metrics.help: Share of each function's lines the tests run.

group.name: C.R.A.P.
group.means: A function that is both complex and poorly covered by tests, so changing it is risky. The published threshold is 30 (Savoia and Evans).
group.todo: Add tests for it, or simplify it; either lowers the score.

findings.help: One finding per function whose C.R.A.P. score is over the threshold.

group.name: Low coverage
group.means: A function the tests cover less than the limit. The published line is coverage below 60% (Google's guidelines).
group.todo: Add tests that run it, or raise the limit if it is wrong.

findings.help: One finding per function whose line coverage is under the limit.
